segments.name: Architectural Glass and Windows
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, distributes and installs high-specification architectural glass and window products for residential and commercial construction markets.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment, Architectural Glass and Windows, which is also its reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: Developers, general contractors and installers pay for architectural glass, window products and installation services on commercial and residential projects.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers, which include developers, general contractors or installers for hotels, office buildings, shopping centers, airports, universities, hospitals and multi-family and residential buildings, look to us as a value-added partner
